title: Vault: full HA status (3 raft nodes + transit seal custodian)
description: Runs `nexus status vault` (+ `--json`) across the Foundation Vault HA cluster. One table rolls up the 3 raft nodes (vault-1/2/3, one active + two standby) plus vault-transit (the Shamir-seal transit custodian). Leaders DRIFT; the active node is read dynamically (vault-2 was active during verify).

observe.what: 4-row table: vault-1/2/3 (one active, two standby) + vault-transit (transit), all alive; active leader read dynamically (was vault-2); overall green
JSON ClusterStatus: 4 members, overallHealth=green, one member role=active and two standby, vault-transit role=transit

whatProves: VaultAdapter.GetStatusAsync classifies the 3 raft nodes by live seal/HA state (active vs standby, read dynamically because leaders drift) and reports vault-transit as the transit seal custodian, rolling all four into the overall health.
